data.name: Retrobot: 2085
data.detailed_description:
From one of the developers behind the genre-defining hit Geometry Wars:

THE ARCADE CLASSICS YOU GREW UP WITH. REBUILT FOR TODAY.

The year is 2085. A runaway mega-intelligence called the Algorithm has decided humanity is obsolete, and unleashed millions of networked humanoid robots to make sure of it. You are one of the anomalies: minds the Algorithm could never map, predict, or control. Grab a controller and start fighting back.

RETROBOT: 2085 is a fast, frantic twin-stick shooter made in the style of a spiritual successor to one of your arcade favourites - a love letter to the golden age of the arcade, modernised with a fully 3D retro art style and that unmistakable 8-bit bleep-and-bloop soundtrack.

  • ENDLESS ROBOTIC HORDES - Dismantle wave after wave of humanoid robots across dozens of levels, each one more relentless than the last.

  • RESCUE THE LAST HUMAN FAMILY - Find every survivor scattered through the level. Reach them and they're rescued instantly for huge bonus points.

  • CHASE THE HIGH SCORE - Classic arcade scoring, extra lives, and a leaderboard to settle who's the best, once and for all. Earn your spot - and your initials - at the top of the table.

  • 4-PLAYER LOCAL MULTIPLAYER - Connect extra controllers and team up with up to three friends for chaotic local multiplayer action.

  • PLAY YOUR WAY - Best with a controller for the full arcade feel, with keyboard & mouse also supported.

  • A SECRET WORTH FINDING - Enter a classic secret code (remember these?) to unlock the hidden Service Menu, where you can switch on classic-style waves and controls for the original arcade experience.

Everything is playable from the start - no purchases required to unlock content, no forced progression systems gating your progress. Just you, an endless robot horde, and a high score table calling your name. How far can you get? Grab a friend (or three) and find out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU, 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU (Apple Silicon integrated or discrete GPU, 1GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in / onboard audio

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or later (64-bit) / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better (Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent, including AMD APUs such as Steam Deck/Steam Machine)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan or OpenGL 4.5 compatible GPU, 1GB VRAM (includes AMD RDNA2+ integrated graphics)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in / onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with Steam Deck and Steam Machine.
